profiles.policyNotes: Primary Google search crawler. Robots token 'Googlebot'; specialized variants (Googlebot-Image, Googlebot-News) share the token prefix. Blocking removes pages from Google Search.
Primary Bing search crawler; also feeds Copilot search grounding. Legacy 'msnbot' tokens retained for historical logs.
Fetches pages for ChatGPT search answers with citation links. Distinct from GPTBot: allowing OAI-SearchBot permits citation visibility without granting training use.
Fetches pages for Perplexity answer engine citations. Perplexity also operates Perplexity-User for user-triggered fetches; this profile covers the declared crawler.
OpenAI model-training crawler. Disallowing GPTBot opts content out of OpenAI training while leaving ChatGPT search citation (OAI-SearchBot) independently controllable.
Anthropic training crawler. Legacy tokens 'Claude-Web' and 'anthropic-ai' retained for historical coverage.
Robots.txt-only token controlling Gemini training and grounding use; it never appears as a fetching User-Agent. Does not affect Google Search inclusion (Googlebot).
Common Crawl corpus crawler; the corpus is widely used for LLM training. Blocking CCBot excludes content from future Common Crawl snapshots.
Apple AI training token, distinct from Applebot (Siri/search). Controls whether content may be used for Apple foundation model training.
Amazon crawler for Alexa/AI services; documented as improving Amazon AI models. Robots token 'Amazonbot'.
ByteDance crawler feeding Doubao and related model training. Frequently observed at high request rates.
Cohere training crawler; documented robots token 'cohere-ai'.
Fetches pages for DuckAssist AI answers (Wikipedia-sourced summaries with citations). Distinct from DuckDuckBot search indexing.
You.com answer-engine crawler with source citations.
